name: Cathy Connolly
prior_offices: Wyoming House District 13, 2009–2022; House minority floor leader (as listed in the 2021–22 legislative directory)
background: Cathy Connolly of Laramie served in the Wyoming House from 2009 to 2022, representing House District 13, and was listed as House minority floor leader in the 2021–22 legislative directory. That directory said she was born Sept. 15, 1956, in Troy, New York; recorded a Ph.D. and J.D. from SUNY Buffalo; and listed her occupation as a professor at the University of Wyoming. It also noted one child.
